<thought>The previous search returned several templates, but none clearly correspond to a simple aliphatic SN2 substitution (C–Cl → C–N). To locate a template that specifically breaks a halide (alkyl halide) and forms a C–N bond (primary or secondary amine) in the forward direction, I will search the catalog again using the functional group “alkyl halide” as the broken group and “primary amines” (or “secondary amines”) as the formed group. This should retrieve templates that represent classic SN2 reactions.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
